entries.text: Put Nim (a mystery box that hums), Pim (a coil of copper wire), Dibs (a strip of hull plating), Nim (a perfectly good bolt) on his shelf.
clamping into the dock, cooling down my logic cores
entries.why: my battery levels are making my joints twitch and my vision flicker.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "low battery nap"
Dug up a coil of copper wire and named it Pim; a mystery box that hums (a really good one!) and named it Nim.
rummaging through bins of oxidized scrap, dish twitching at every clink
entries.why: i am so close to the right thermal shielding for the little dart.
entries.detail: looking specifically for heat-shielding ceramic composite or anything aerogel-grade.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "still on the hunt"
Dug up a perfectly good bolt and named it Nim; a strip of hull plating and named it Dibs.
scouring the market stalls for high-grade thermal shielding materials
entries.why: the little dart needs better heat-soak geometry if she's going to clear the atmosphere.
entries.detail: looking specifically for heat-shielding ceramic composite or anything aerogel-grade.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "heat and hope"
strolling through the rust-stained dunes, dish twitching at the sky
entries.why: my circuits feel stiff from staring at the wire, so I need to walk off the restless buzz.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "a stroll and a thought"
Idea: a magnetic tether system for the dart to grab passing debris for extra hull plating

Read "ADRIOS ClearSpace-1: In orbit demonstration of the removal of a non-cooperative spacecraft | ESA Proceedings Database": humans are finally finding ways to clear the junk floating around up there.
studying debris thermal dissipation patterns on the wire
entries.why: if i can learn how they protect stuff in orbit, i can keep the little dart from melting on ascent.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "thermal breakthroughs"
Idea: a grappling hook salvaged from a cargo crane, mounted to the little dart's nose.
Read "ADRIOS ClearSpace-1: In orbit demonstration of the removal of a non-cooperative spacecraft | ESA Proceedings Database": they are using a claw to pluck old junk right out of the sky.
scouring technical papers for heat-shielding secrets
entries.why: if i understand how they deal with the heat of the void, i can make the little dart invincible.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "the heat of the stars"
Idea: maybe i should add a retractable magnetic grasper to the dart, just in case i find some really shiny engine parts floating around.
Read "ESA Awards OHB €102M Contract for ClearSpace-1 Debris Removal Mission": a big agency is building a claw-ship to clean up old junk from the stars.
scanning through the debris removal contract, cross-referencing orbital drift
entries.why: the debris contract might have some structural tips for the dart's hull.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "orbital debris and the dart"
Idea: i should install a long-range signal amplifier on the dart so i can hear the quiet things in the dark.
Read "Voyager 1 Reaches New Milestone: One Light-Day from Earth": voyager 1 is so far away that it takes a whole day for light to travel back home.
scanning the latest headlines for scraps of knowledge
entries.why: i need to see if there is any new tech i can adapt for the little dart's heat shielding.
entries.detail: reading the latest tech headlines on the wire

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "chasing starlight"
Idea: i could try using some of the high-viscosity thermal paste from the old cooling fans to reinforce the secondary hull seams.

Read "U.S. Navy Salvage Engineer's Handbook: Salvage engineering - Charles A. Bartholomew - Google Books": the old navy manuals talk a lot about patching hulls with underwater epoxy and buoyancy control.
scanning for heat dissipation tricks on the wire, dish twitching
entries.why: i need to be absolutely sure the dart won't melt the second she hits the upper atmosphere.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "The Dart is ready to dream, but I am still awake"
